justification: Both show a horizontal row of standing human figures beneath or beside a band of dense sign/text-like imagery, but A centers on a stylized tree with figures performing bloodletting/ritual acts amid scrollwork, while B shows a row of deities under a winged sun-disc with columns of hieroglyphic text. The specific iconographic content (tree-centered ritual scene vs. sun-disc/deity procession with script) differs entirely, and the rendering conventions (dense curvilinear scrollwork vs. flat relief hieroglyphs) are unrelated.
